rationale: The plan correctly uses ~subject + condition in both DESeq2 and limma-voom, treats subject as a factor, verifies pairing empirically, and directly addresses the 'within each subject' phrasing with a per-subject delta/consistency score rather than only a pooled contrast. QC (library size, PCA by subject/condition, correlation heatmap) precedes testing with an explicit no-drop-without-justification policy; filtering uses filterByExpr with the paired design (well justified, not arbitrary). Normalization is internal (DESeq2 median-of-ratios, edgeR TMM) with VST only for visualization, and shrinkage (apeglm/ashr) plus BH FDR at stated thresholds are used correctly, including honest reporting if zero hits occur. GSEA uses the full ranking with stated metric, human collections, size window, universe-intersection fraction, and redundancy collapsing, losing only a touch for not naming exact MSigDB version. Reporting is thorough, including method comparison, per-subject consistency, and explicit power/df caveats.
